label: Shotcut open-source editor
summary: Use the installed Shotcut application for local timeline editing, captions, manual picture review, and editable MLT projects without a hosted account or cloud upload.

handoffs.label: Prepare a local Shotcut project package
handoffs.intent: Bring a reviewed, disposable EPRS picture candidate and guide audio into a local open-source timeline-editing session without changing the source of truth.
inputs: An eprs.shotcut-project/v1 score and song-relative reviewed picture candidate
A song-relative guide/master audio file, beat map, and visual brief
outputs: A validated editable Shotcut MLT project and checksum manifest
A non-overwriting melt render candidate and technical sidecar
steps: Compile the structured score with eprs shotcut compile; the command rejects raw and outside-workspace inputs and validates the MLT graph with a null render.
Render a new candidate with eprs shotcut render and preserve the exact project, original-media references, service inventory, checksums, and stream facts.
Optionally run eprs shotcut open for a subjective GUI pass; never save over a master or prior candidate.
verification: Confirm the generated MLT has Shotcut annotations, a main bin, black background, named tracks, original resources, and a successful melt null render.
Confirm the source master and raw-material boundaries are unchanged and ffprobe verifies the new render before picture review.

handoffs.label: Edit local timeline and captions
handoffs.intent: Make subjective pacing, caption, crop, and visual-structure decisions in a local human-reviewed timeline while preserving the musical edit as the source of truth.
inputs: A local MLT project and disposable media package
A musical cue map, beat markers, captions, or visual brief
outputs: An exported picture candidate with captions and visual decisions recorded
steps: Use the beat map and timestamp notes to align cuts, captions, and visual changes with identity, pocket, contrast, hook, and turnaround.
Inspect the full timeline at normal speed; do not treat a technically valid export as creative approval.
Export to a new candidate path and leave the MLT project available for later revision.
verification: Check duration, frame size, frame rate, audio mapping, caption readability, and sync with ffprobe and local playback.
Check for accidental private text, source-domain identifiers, unlicensed media, and unexpected overlays.

handoffs.label: Return a Shotcut picture candidate
handoffs.intent: Bring a locally exported Shotcut render back into the normal EPRS picture-review and release path.
inputs: A new local Shotcut export and its MLT project
The approved EPRS master, source manifest, and intended picture duration
outputs: A song-local picture candidate with checksums and review notes
steps: Save the export as a new candidate; never overwrite the master, raw material, or FINAL package.
Run the normal EPRS picture review, rights, privacy, and technical checks.
Rebuild any release package from the local approved master and reviewed picture only.
verification: Confirm the candidate starts at master time zero and preserves the intended audio relationship.
Confirm MLT, export, captions, provenance, and rights notes are retained together before publication.

preserve: EPRS masters, raw-material boundaries, provenance, rights evidence, captions, local picture review, and YouTube publishing control
A reversible local MLT project with its exact media references and edit notes
avoid: Cloud uploads, account authentication, remote publication, in-place edits, raw/private source material, and unlicensed stock media
Treating a Shotcut export as approved without local technical and creative review
